title: Existence of compatible open restriction choices
statement: For f:X→S, g:S′→S with g and g′ flat, F an O_X-module, I an injective resolution of F, J an injective resolution of g′^*F, and every open V⊂S, FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V is inhabited. This requires the canonical restricted unit square, the augmentation-preserving resolution isomorphisms and the pinned section components in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], not arbitrary section isomorphisms.

proof.text:
Restrict I and J termwise to U = f⁻¹V and W = g'⁻¹U. Transport the exactness and injectivity of overFunctor across overFunctorEquiv (as in the existing proof of module_sections_acyclic_of_cohomology_vanishing). Thus restrictFunctor is exact and preserves injectives, so the restricted augmentations give resolutions of
 the restricted modules. Identify sections using restrictAppIso, evaluated at
 the top open, followed by the equality that the inclusion maps the top to U
 (respectively W). These identifications satisfy the specified components.
 Restrict the original pullback unit to U and transpose across restriction's
 adjunction to define psi. On an open T in U, the unit sends m to 1 tensor m;
 restricting the original unit gives the same map on h⁻¹T. With the canonical
 pushforward composition identifications this is exactly unit_square. Bundle
 these choices to obtain the required inhabitant.

from.place: lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-map-sections: Existence of compatible open restriction choices

lean.statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeMap_sections_choices {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [Flat g] [Flat (pullback.snd g f)] (F : X.Modules) :
    ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F)
      (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)) (V : S.Opens),
      Nonempty (FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
